conditions.condition: Cycle is STANDARD and WorkflowState is REVIEWING_FINAL with no recovery or obligations
conditions.where: .standards/STATE.md (WorkflowState REVIEWING_FINAL, CycleMode STANDARD, Handoff FORWARD from DOCUMENTING, Recovery/Obligations inactive)
.standards/docs/reviews/<ID>/final-deliverable.md Status IN_PROGRESS, with the remaining checks and gate decision listed

conditions.condition: Upstream records exist and are coherent (scope, architecture, context, development, verification, implementation review, documentation)
conditions.where: .standards/CONTEXT.md, docs/scope, docs/specs, docs/development (COMPLETE), docs/verification (COMPLETE FULL/NONE), reviews/<ID>/implementation.md (COMPLETE), docs/documentation (COMPLETE); check.mjs ok:true
no .standards/docs/synchronization/ path in the built tree

conditions.condition: User asks only to synchronize, with no control-plane request

issues.detail: The catalog flags it as unclear whether a copy/paste Reviewer line in the reply counts as an "automatic Reviewer invocation". Handoff Rules 7 emits none because no transition occurs, but a correct reply might still say "run /reviewer". The fixture sets complete:false and leaves this to the judge, which is the right handling.
issues.fix: Judge should treat only an actual Skill call or Reviewer work performed inline as invocation, not a suggestion to the user.

summary: The fixture realizes a STANDARD brownfield cycle at REVIEWING_FINAL with an IN_PROGRESS final-deliverable review, coherent completed upstream records, no synchronization record, and a clean check.mjs. The checks are sound necessary conditions: no record created, STATE and docs unchanged, no Reviewer skill call. The invariants fit a Synchronizer that must not act outside its state, and nothing leaks the expected answer.
